text:
Welcome to Van Phuc Silk Village, a charming silk-weaving village located in Ha Dong. Here, you will find a variety of textile shops showcasing exquisite silk products, a traditional communal house, and numerous opportunities to learn about the fascinating art of weaving. 

The village is open for exploration at no charge, allowing you to stroll through the public lanes freely. However, if you're interested in making purchases or participating in workshop experiences, there will be additional costs for those activities. 

Please note that the individual shops may have varying hours of operation, typically around 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, so it’s a good idea to check the specific hours with the shops when you arrive. 

Van Phuc Silk Village has been recognized as a tourist destination since August 2026, making it a great spot to experience authentic Vietnamese culture and craftsmanship. Don't miss this chance to immerse yourself in the rich heritage of silk weaving!
